producer_report.summary:
I wrote docs/design/reviews/decision-sets-review-1.md. The verdict is accept with changes, and F1 to F4 must be settled before any build. I added a bullet for the review to CHANGELOG.md and edited no other design doc. The review had to run without records/, so the repeat counts and the reported HTTP 405 stay unverified.

The review covers fit across the four parts, 9 findings by severity, a Jev check against POST /v1/evaluate, claims checked against code, the smallest first build, and the 8 changes needed.

The four High findings:
- **Reader budget:** the reader token set measured 1798 of 1800, so decision sets cannot be added there. `check_budget` has no job-time caller; only tests enforce budgets. The open question about producer and verifier budgets is answered: defaults sit outside those budgeted sets.
- **Typed fields for defaults:** `defaults.toml` rejects unknown fields, so assumptions and signals for a default have nowhere to live.
- **Failure signals:** host errors have no record. The merge call discards the HTTP status and keeps only error text. The D87 example would also need a trigger at landing time, which the design does not have.
- **Evidence standard:** a decision goes under review on one event, but a new default needs three jobs, and the designs do not say why. The D87 example also labels D87 `code-check`, which D87's own text contradicts.

**Jev check:** the request fields match. The review lists mismatches on question shape for set membership, the threshold for boolean answers, and the input fields. It also notes the response shape for multi-question calls is unknown.

**Smallest first build:** a read-only backtest of D87 and D88 only, with no Jev and no brief change. It passes if the supersession parse finds the known hits and D87 is flagged from at least 2 real jobs. It also requires that no other decision is flagged and every cited id exists.

open_issues: records/ was absent, so no record id or count could be checked. The 405 and the repeat counts stay unverified.
Jev facts rest on defaults-loop.md section 6, which is itself only reported. No gateway call was made.
The producer's proposed first build depends on records existing for the PR #39/#40 landings. That is unknown until the build's step 2.
mistakes: The first CHANGELOG edit failed because the heading 'Added' is not unique. I retried with more context.
I did not run the full cargo test or clippy. They are unaffected by Markdown-only changes, and Athena will run them.
learnings: check_budget in athena-context has no job-time caller. Budgets are enforced by tests (crates/athena-cli/tests/budgets.rs) on static sets only, and the live counter is an opt-in test for the contract.
The measured reader set is 1798 of 1800 tokens (estimator), so there is no room for decision sets there.
Producer and verifier budget tests compose only contract, frame and capability section. The per-job 'User defaults that apply' brief section (briefs.rs line 158) is outside them.
GhCli::gh keeps only stderr text on failure, with no HTTP status field.
OutcomeState::Rejected exists in records, so decision-sets.md's 'no record for rejections' is partly wrong.
DefaultsModel uses deny_unknown_fields, so assumptions and signals cannot go into defaults.toml without a governance job.
CHANGELOG.md already had a bullet for the decision-sets design; I added one above it for the review.
desires: records/ in the snapshot, to check the repeat counts, the PR #39/#40 landings and the reported 405.
A way to read the gateway contract from a source other than defaults-loop.md section 6.
